outcome: branch (b) partial: preservation helps but a residual penalty survives, so the mechanism is more than the routing head
summary_note: Section 5.24. R and Rp are the same seed, initial model and data schedule, differing only in whether a mutated layer's learned router survives the rebuild. R_own and Rp_own are the frozen retrains of each fused run's own final genome, so R_own-R and Rp_own-Rp are the two penalties. Negative means the first-named run won.
